resources.string: All three things at once: an SOS message to your emergency contacts, the siren, and your GPS location with a maps link.
SOS message sent to your emergency contacts.
Could not send the SOS message. Check your network and that you have at least one emergency contact.
No emergency contacts available. Add them on the Emergency Contacts screen before you send an SOS.
Current location obtained — coordinates and maps link included.
Siren activated — tap \u201cStop Siren\u201d or leave the app to stop it.
Location permission is required for coordinates. Turn it on in system settings.
No SIM detected — SMS cannot be sent.
No mobile network — SMS cannot be sent right now.
FloodCue will send this SMS from your phone. It may use mobile network minutes/charges. Tap Send to continue.
